name: Arizona Furnishings
old_description: The State of Arizona is just emerging from the 2009 recession. We at Arizona Furnishings have been here for you since 1996. We stuck with you through the down times, so now as funding begins to return let’s keep our dollars in Arizona. Please choose Arizona Furnishings, your local “Subject Matter Experts.”
about:
Arizona Furnishings has operated from Phoenix, Arizona since 1996. Founded as a local furniture provider, the company weathered the 2009 recession and continues to serve the Arizona market, emphasizing its role as a community-focused supplier.

The firm offers complete design and space-planning services at no cost or obligation, alongside a range of warrantied furniture products sold at competitive pricing. Its service model emphasizes customer-centric support, including dedicated representatives for procurement and project coordination. The company does not manufacture its own products but sources from established brands to fulfill orders.

Arizona Furnishings serves organizations across Arizona, targeting businesses, government agencies, and educational institutions that require office and commercial furnishings. The company positions itself as a local subject-matter expert for interior environments, though specific industry verticals are not publicly detailed.

The company cites its commitment to quality, value, service, and integrity as differentiators, noting that it redefined service expectations for consumers by providing free design services and maintaining a customer-first approach. These principles are presented as the foundation of its long-term client relationships.
